verses.text: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
lines: I am the man who has seen affliction
by the rod of his wrath.

verses.text: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
lines: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness,
and not in light.

verses.text: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
lines: Surely he turns his hand against me
again and again all day long.

verses.text: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
lines: He has made my flesh and my skin old.
He has broken my bones.

verses.text: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
lines: He has built against me,
and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

verses.text: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
lines: He has made me dwell in dark places,
as those who have been long dead.

verses.text: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
lines: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out.
He has made my chain heavy.

verses.text: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
lines: Yes, when I cry, and call for help,
he shuts out my prayer.

verses.text: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
lines: He has walled up my ways with cut stone.
He has made my paths crooked.

verses.text: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
lines: He is to me as a bear lying in wait,
as a lion in secret places.

verses.text: He has turned away my ways, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.
lines: He has turned away my ways,
and pulled me in pieces.
He has made me desolate.

verses.text: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
lines: He has bent his bow,
and set me as a mark for the arrow.

verses.text: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
lines: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

verses.text: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
lines: I have become a derision to all my people,
and their song all day long.

verses.text: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
lines: He has filled me with bitterness.
He has stuffed me with wormwood.

verses.text: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
lines: He has also broken my teeth with gravel.
He has covered me with ashes.

verses.text: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
lines: You have removed my soul far away from peace.
I forgot prosperity.

verses.text: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from Yahweh.”
lines: I said, “My strength has perished,
along with my expectation from Yahweh.”

verses.text: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
lines: Remember my affliction and my misery,
the wormwood and the bitterness.

verses.text: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
lines: My soul still remembers them,
and is bowed down within me.

verses.text: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
lines: This I recall to my mind;
therefore I have hope.

verses.text: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail.
lines: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed,
because his compassion doesn’t fail.

verses.text: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
lines: They are new every morning.
Great is your faithfulness.

verses.text: “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
lines: “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul.
“Therefore I will hope in him.”

verses.text: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
lines: Yahweh is good to those who wait for him,
to the soul who seeks him.

verses.text: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
lines: It is good that a man should hope
and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.

verses.text: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
lines: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

verses.text: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
lines: Let him sit alone and keep silence,
because he has laid it on him.

verses.text: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.
lines: Let him put his mouth in the dust,
if it is so that there may be hope.

verses.text: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
lines: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him.
Let him be filled full of reproach.

verses.text: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
lines: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

verses.text: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
lines: For though he causes grief,
yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

verses.text: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
lines: For he does not afflict willingly,
nor grieve the children of men.

verses.text: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
lines: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

verses.text: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
lines: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

verses.text: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
lines: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.

verses.text: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
lines: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass,
when the Lord doesn’t command it?

verses.text: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
lines: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

verses.text: Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
lines: Why does a living man complain,
a man for the punishment of his sins?

verses.text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Yahweh.
lines: Let us search and try our ways,
and turn again to Yahweh.

verses.text: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
lines: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.

verses.text: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.
lines: “We have transgressed and have rebelled.
You have not pardoned.

verses.text: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
lines: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us.
You have killed.
You have not pitied.

verses.text: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
lines: You have covered yourself with a cloud,
so that no prayer can pass through.

verses.text: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
lines: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse
in the middle of the peoples.

verses.text: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
lines: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

verses.text: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”
lines: Terror and the pit have come on us,
devastation and destruction.”

verses.text: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
lines: My eye runs down with streams of water,
for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

verses.text: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
lines: My eye pours down
and doesn’t cease,
without any intermission,

verses.text: until Yahweh looks down, and sees from heaven.
lines: until Yahweh looks down,
and sees from heaven.

verses.text: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
lines: My eye affects my soul,
because of all the daughters of my city.

verses.text: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
lines: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird,
those who are my enemies without cause.

verses.text: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
lines: They have cut off my life in the dungeon,
and have cast a stone on me.

verses.text: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
lines: Waters flowed over my head.
I said, “I am cut off.”

verses.text: I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.
lines: I called on your name, Yahweh,
out of the lowest dungeon.

verses.text: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
lines: You heard my voice:
“Don’t hide your ear from my sighing,
and my cry.”

verses.text: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
lines: You came near in the day that I called on you.
You said, “Don’t be afraid.”

verses.text: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.
lines: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul.
You have redeemed my life.

verses.text: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
lines: Yahweh, you have seen my wrong.
Judge my cause.

verses.text: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.
lines: You have seen all their vengeance
and all their plans against me.

verses.text: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their plans against me,
lines: You have heard their reproach, Yahweh,
and all their plans against me,

verses.text: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.
lines: the lips of those that rose up against me,
and their plots against me all day long.

verses.text: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.
lines: You see their sitting down and their rising up.
I am their song.

verses.text: You will pay them back, Yahweh, according to the work of their hands.
lines: You will pay them back, Yahweh,
according to the work of their hands.

verses.text: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
lines: You will give them hardness of heart,
your curse to them.

verses.text: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.
lines: You will pursue them in anger,
and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.
